PSumOperand.Comment: Fetch the single field that is a credit card number and condition it, so that is looks like: nnnn nnnn nnnn nnnn. Optionally will do a mod 11 check and if its invalid spew out a warning about the content to the log.

Demonstration of looking for a fist and last name within 10 words of each other. Since the first and last name are in seperate fields they are fetched and merged with a space as the seperator before passing onto the name formatter which simply lower cases the string.
